## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** 湖北省文物考古研究院与云梦县博物馆报告清理 113 座墓葬，其中 40 座饱水墓。三墓简牍共登记 622 个编号，涉及基层军事管理、女子教诫及数术；漆木器与墓葬背景提供相关物质资料。

**English.** The Hubei institute and Yunmeng County Museum report 113 tombs, including 40 waterlogged burials. Manuscripts from three tombs have 622 catalogue numbers and concern local military administration, instructions concerning women and divinatory knowledge; lacquerware and burial contexts add material evidence.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 发掘始于 2026 年 4 月；机构公告和国家文物局发布会为 2026-11-18。M64 属秦汉之际，M74、M116 属秦代，不能统称 622 枚完整秦简。新华社具名采访确认项目负责人为赵军。

**English.** Excavation began in April 2026; the institute release and national briefing date to 2026-11-18. M64 is transitional Qin–Han, while M74 and M116 are Qin; the count is not 622 complete Qin slips. A named Xinhua interview identifies project director Zhao Jun.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 完整影版、释文、拼缀及逐墓对应仍待核。墓中文书不能直接确定墓主官职；本页不转载未经技术资料复核的最早冶金或水稻 DNA 比较性判断。

**English.** Images, readings, joins and tomb associations need fuller publication. Grave texts do not establish the occupant’s office. Unreviewed metallurgy-firstness and rice-DNA claims are not adopted.

## 补充证据审读 | Evidence review {#evidence-review-2026-11-24}

**评议。** 发掘简报图 8–9 将防务簿籍与秦墓 M116 联系起来。50 枚竹简列出沙羡县十余处亭、障的名称，但发布材料详列数量的只有赤丘、步东两亭：包括粮秣和铜料等储备、环壕尺寸，以及人员、车辆和武器配置。三墓共 622 个编号与这一份 50 枚竹简不是同一统计单位。发掘机构将其认定为目前所见中国最早的同类武备簿籍，这是发掘方的比较判断。现有资料支持研究秦代县以下如何登记防务，却不能确定各亭执行是否一致、账面配置是否实际到位，或者该文书是否为墓主履职所用。完整释文、编制日期和墓内位置仍是后续核查关键。

**Assessment.** Figures 8–9 in the excavation briefing associate the defence inventory with Qin tomb M116. Fifty bamboo slips name more than ten posts and barriers in Shaxian County; the detailed quantities released concern just two posts, Chiqiu and Budong. They cover stores including grain, fodder and copper, ditch dimensions, personnel, vehicles and weapons. The 622 catalogue numbers from three tombs are not the count of slips in this document. The excavators describe the find as the earliest known military preparedness inventory of its kind in China. It offers evidence of local defence recordkeeping, but it cannot establish uniform countywide practice, actual readiness or the office of the person buried with it. The complete text, date of compilation and position in the tomb remain important checks.
